detection_capability_statement: On 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900K (Linux 7.0.0-31-generic), unmodified ML-KEM-512 decaps (2084.8 us median, IQR 41.3 us) reliably detects injected secret-dependent delays >= 5 us (Spearman rho_binary >= +0.0844, acc 54.36%, p < 1/201 (0.0050)); rolling-median detrending (W=51) lowers/matches threshold to >= 5 us (Spearman rho_binary >= +0.0830, acc 54.16%, p < 1/201 (0.0050)).
